planned_by: Claude (Critic): production home AI status stayed idle
goal:
T75 — live Arena progress (owner: "type and watch the result evolve live"). Production 2026-10-30: a running prompt
Arena showed no lane events at all — each lane appends to a local `events` list that is stored only when the lane
finishes — so the home "AI status" panel stayed idle the whole run. API only.
1. While an Arena runs (prompt first round, prompt follow-up, and sealed mode), GET /v1/arena/{id} and GET /v1/arena
   (the list the home workspace reads) show each lane's events as they are emitted (seq strictly increasing, same
   messages as the final document, which they must be a prefix of). Keep it in process memory (a lock-protected live
   overlay keyed by arena id, cleared when the final document is saved); do NOT write the store per event.
2. Hidden acceptance test names are scrubbed in live events exactly as _scrub_lane does for the final document (the
   names are known once the judge suite is filtered, before the lanes start).
3. Prompt Arenas get a top-level "events" list with the judge's step, e.g. {"role": "judge", "message": "Judge wrote 3
   acceptance tests (hidden from both lanes)"} — visible live and kept in the final document.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t75.py.
